service.method: SELECT NOTICE_NUMBER , HOUSE_CODE , SUBJECT , PUBLISH_FROM_DATE , PUBLISH_TO_DATE FROM SNOTE WHERE HOUSE_CODE = ${CLIENT_CODE} AND GONGJI_GUBUN = 'A' AND POPUP_LOCATION = 'M' AND #DB_OWNER#NVL(DEL_FLAG, 'N') = 'N' AND ROWNUM >= 1 AND ROWNUM <= 4 ORDER BY ADD_DATE DESC , ADD_TIME DESC
